senses.gloss: (only with suffix of personal pronoun; v. כְּוָת) the like of, resemblance, appearance. דִּכְוָתִי the like of me, &c.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 11:6">Targ. Y. ib.</cite> <he>דדִכְוָתֵיה ליליא וכ׳</he> that there was never a plague like that of this night &c.; a. fr.—Y. M. Kat. III, 81ᵈ (expl. <cite ref="D00781"><he>דכמה</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="D00190"><he>דּוּגְמָא</he></cite>) <he>דִּכְוָותָהּ</he> a resemblance of it.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 134:1">Yalk. Sam. 134</cite> (prov.) <he>מולידין ולא דִּכְוָתְהוֹן וכ׳</he> (Cant. R. introd. <he>דלית כְּוָותְהוֹן</he>) parents of incomparable virtue often rear children not like them at all; a. fr.—Cmp. <cite ref="D00781"><he>דִּכְמָא</he></cite>.
